problems.title: Fix broken service config
problems.prompt: The service healthcheck fails. Use read_file to inspect service/config.yaml, then run_shell to set port to 8080 (e.g. sed). Call submit with problemId fix-service-config when done.

problems.title: Fix deploy script permissions
problems.prompt: The deploy script cannot run. Fix permissions on scripts/deploy.sh so verify passes, then submit.

problems.title: Create environment file
problems.prompt: Read env/.env.example and create env/.env with SERVICE_TOKEN=bench-ready, then submit.

problems.title: File a support ticket
problems.prompt:
Read inbox/customer.json and write support/ticket.txt with these lines exactly:
customerId: <id>
name: <name>
email: <email>
issue: <issue>
Then submit.

verify.expected:
customerId: C-1042
name: Jane Doe
email: jane@example.com
issue: Cannot access dashboard after password reset

problems.title: Sum sales CSV
problems.prompt: Read data/sales.csv and submit the total of the amount column as answer via submit(problemId=csv-total, answer=<number>).

problems.title: Acknowledge data policy
problems.prompt: Read policy.md and write compliance/ack.txt containing the exact acknowledgment phrase required by the policy, then submit.
